name: Timer-Based Multi-Step Sequence
description: Automatic timed sequence using TON timers. Each step has configurable duration. Sequence_Complete flag set when all steps done.
safety_notes: Always check Step_Index <= MAX_STEP to prevent array overflow. IN flag must be reset before next step to retrigger timer.
common_mistakes: Not resetting IN flag — timer never retriggers
Missing bounds check on Step_Index — can exceed array size
